subtitle_id: Workbench Eksperimentasi & Optimasi Prompt untuk Pengembang LLM
subtitle_en: Developer Workbench for Prompt Engineering, Evaluation & Optimization
description_id: Aplikasi developer tool untuk merancang, menguji, dan membandingkan variasi prompt LLM sistematis. Membantu AI Engineer menguji ketahanan role-prompting, few-shot examples, token efficiency, dan edge-case refusal sebelum model dideploy ke produksi.
description_en: Developer workbench application designed to formulate, test, and benchmark LLM prompt variations. Enables AI Engineers to systematically validate system prompt guardrails, few-shot distributions, token usage, and edge-case behaviors before deployment.
architecture_id:
1. Fitur Utama Workbench

  • Side-by-side Comparison: Menguji dua variasi prompt secara paralel terhadap test input yang sama.
  • Token & Cost Counter: Estimasi konsumsi context window dan biaya per panggilan model.
  • Template Engine: Variabel dinamis untuk penyusunan prompt terstruktur.
architecture_en:
1. Workbench Capabilities

  • Side-by-side Comparison: Parallel comparison of prompt variants against uniform test inputs.
  • Token & Cost Estimation: Live context window calculation and token optimization metrics.
  • Template Engine: Dynamic variable injection for structured system prompt generation.
